name: Scythecat Cub
oracle_text:
Trample
Landfall — Whenever a land you control enters, put a +1/+1 counter on target creature you control. If this is the second time this ability has resolved this turn, double the number of +1/+1 counters on that creature instead.
blocked_sentences: If this is the second time this ability has resolved this turn, double the number of +1/+1 counters on that creature instead.

needs.what: a per-turn, per-ability resolution counter the DSL can read, e.g. {"resolutions_this_turn": "self"} evaluating to how many times *this printed triggered ability* has already resolved this turn (counting the resolution in progress), reset in the turn ledger alongside `spells_cast` and `creatures_died`. Wanted here as the condition of an `if`: {"cmp": {"left": {"resolutions_this_turn": "self"}, "op": "==", "right": {"const": 2}}}, whose `then` branch is {"op": "add_counters", "counter": "+1/+1", "amount": {"counters_on": {"counter": "+1/+1", "objects": {"target": true}}}, "objects": {"target": true}} and whose `else` branch adds one counter
needs.why_existing_wont_do: Everything else on this card is already sayable: the trigger is `permanent_enters` filtered to Lands you control, the doubling is `add_counters` with an amount of `counters_on` the target, and `if` already has `then`/`else` so the printed "instead" needs no replacement machinery. The only unsayable part is the count. `value_keys` reaches the turn ledger for spells cast, creatures died, cards drawn, damage taken, life lost and cards to graveyard, but nothing counts ability resolutions -- and there is no lands-entered-this-turn value to stand in for it either (which would be wrong anyway: the printed text counts resolutions of the ability, not land drops, so a countered or fizzled trigger must not advance it). `set_flag`/`has_flag` is the nearest recording mechanism and it is the wrong shape twice over: it is explicitly one-way (`op_set_flag` only adds to `obj.flags`, there is no clear_flag op and nothing empties `flags` at end of turn), so a flag written on the first landfall would still be set on every later turn and would make the *third* and every subsequent resolution double as well, instead of only the second. Faking the reset with an extra end-step ability that erases the mark is also barred: it implements no printed sentence, so the residual gate rejects the card.
